title: Add header-flags to IAKerb
description:
- Update spnego.asn implementation with header flags
- Define header-flag mapping

The Microsoft implementation of IAKerb leverages the
header-flag field within the IAKerb header to denote the
DC locator flags for the receiving server.

notes.body:
added 5 commits
  • 1b4afaaa...956fab79 - 4 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 744233dd - Add header-flags to IAKerb
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19213/diffs?diff_id=1286781738&start_sha=1b4afaaabc6aca1cc14e07076fed98a026b3ebbb)
@WAftring is IAKerb already available in public Windows builds?

commits_data.title: Add header-flags to IAKerb
commits_data.message:
Add header-flags to IAKerb

- Update spnego.asn implementation with header flags
- Define header-flag mapping

The Microsoft implementation of IAKerb leverages the
header-flag field within the IAKerb header to denote the
DC locator flags for the receiving server.
